scoring_justification: Checker recomputes phase‑dominance conditions and TiN appearance from the raw CSV tables; threshold consistency cross‑checks the CSV with the reported number. T1 is feasible because all required information is present in the agent’s output files.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference thresholds for TiN appearance pressure and phase dominance criteria at specific paper‑reported {T, p} points.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from the paper text and Figures 1–2: “At 950 °C and pressure 1.3×10⁻³ Pa, TiB₂ is the only solid phase” and “At 1750 °C the pressure value for which only this solid phase is stable decreases to 2×10⁴ Pa”; TiN appearance threshold approximated from Fig. 1 as ~1×10⁵ Pa.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Approximate value from the published equilibrium diagram with a generous tolerance factor of 3 to accommodate legitimate Gibbs‑solver spread.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Numbers are based on the paper’s own reported qualitative/pictorial findings, not invented arbitrarily.

schema.description: Single floating-point number representing pressure in Pa.

outputs.description: Threshold pressure for TiN appearance at 950 °C.

output_contract.notes: The solving agent must use a Gibbs energy minimization routine and public thermochemical data. The JANAF tables provide the required species data; any equivalent source is acceptable. The threshold step is load-bearing to prevent bypassing the full equilibrium computation.

steps.description: Verify TiB₂/TiN dominance and gas presence at paper‑stated 950 °C conditions
Verify TiB₂ sole solid at 2×10⁴ Pa and TiN presence at high pressure at 1750 °C
Check that the reported TiN threshold is consistent with equilibrium_950C.csv and lies within the paper‑expected range (≈1×10⁵ Pa ±0.5 log₁₀)
